parameters.text:
Extract data from this invoice. Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown, using exactly this shape:
{"supplier": string, "bill_to": string, "invoice_number": string, "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "currency": "3-letter ISO code", "line_items": [{"description": string, "quantity": number, "unit_price": number, "amount": number}], "subtotal": number, "tax": number, "total": number, "confidence": number from 0 to 100}
Rules:
- "supplier" is the party that ISSUED the invoice (the Name or From block at the top). It is never the Bill To customer. Put the Bill To customer in "bill_to".
- All dates are DD-MM-YYYY: read the first number as the day and the second as the month. Output the date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- Infer currency from symbols ($ = USD, € = EUR, £ = GBP, ₦ = NGN).
- Use null for any field you cannot read clearly. Never guess or invent values.
- Lower the confidence score if the image is blurry, skewed, shadowed or any digit is unclear.
